description: Land Acquisition - Ulavanoor, Kandawalai D/S Division, Kilinochchi District - Amendment to notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. 1803/23 of 27.03.2013 by Tamankaduwa D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of land locations, lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and procedures for compensation claims. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land acquisition, property descriptions, and related administrative procedures.
